title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations version 4.172.3589.2. release
body:
We are announcing the rollout of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations hotfix version 4.172.3589.2. This version will begin deploying on October 30, 2026.

 
How does this affect me?
 
The hotfix deployment will follow an expedited deployment schedule to complete over the next 48 hours.

 
There is no expected impact to service performance or availability during the maintenance window.

 
What action do I need to take?
 
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.
